reviews.reviewbody:
Please try to upload chaukhambha sanskrit hindi translations by sn khandelwal of the following granthas
Sn khandelwal sanskrit hindi: 
1. shiva purana,
2. skanda purana ( last 8 volumes the first two namely maheshwara khanda uploaded by you and the vaishnava khanda both these are already available)
3. Kalika purana
4. Markandeya purana
5. Varaha purana
6. Padma purana
7. Vayu purana

Up puranas not available sanskrit hindi by chaukhambha: shiva dharmottara, shiva dharma, devi purana, vishnu dharmottara , saur purana 

Tantras of sn khandelwal not uploaded yet: rudrayamala uttara tantra, kamakhya tantra, yogini tantra, gyanarnava tantra, kularnava tantra, mantra maharnava,  todala tantra and nirvana tantra, kubjika tantra, sharada tilaka, nitya shodashi karnava, purascharan rahasya, renuka tantra and Renuka tantra and prachand chandika tantra, kumari tantra 

Based on shri vidya not available: 
tantraraja tantra by kapil dev narayan not available, devi rahasya part 2 not available 

Yogini hridaya by Acharya mrityunjaya tripathi not available 

By sn khandelwal:gyanarnava tantra, kularnava tantra, nitya shodashi karnava not available

Tripura sara samuchaya by madhu

Lalitopākhyānam english translation by giri ratna mishra not available 
other texts by giri ratna mishra not available: kali tantra and rudra chandi tantra, bhuta damara tantra, shri baglatatva prakashika, encyclopedia of shabara mantras

Shri vidya antargata baglamukhi mahavidya, Bala tripura sundari, gayatri brahma vidya by goswami prahlad giri not available 

Other tantras not available:
 of Ajay Kumar Uttam many like kamakhya tantra, niruttara tantra, 
Shakti sahasranama stotra sangraha

 By kapil dev narayan not available tantrarajtantra, devi rahasya part 2, akash bhairava kalpa, kali pooja paddhati, mahanirvana tantra 

By sudhakar Malaviya not available: kamadhenu tantra,  agama rahasyam part 2, prapancha sara, shakti sangama tantra

By radhe shyam chaturvedi not available: shakti sangama tantra, mahakala samhita,tarini parijat kalpa, shri kali and tara karpura stotrams

By ram kumar rai: not available shaktananda tarangini 

Phetkarini tantra

By pradip kumar rai: not available kubjika tantra, kankal malini tantra, maya tantra, kumari tantra, gupta sadhana tantra , Neel tantra, agama tattva vilasa, shyama rahasyam
